title: Generation gets its own API home
summary:
Generation moved to its own API home, Nova Reel gained reproducible seeds, and app keys gained multiple callback URLs.

Image, video, text, chat, and speech generation routes moved to `gen.pollinations.ai`, along with the interactive API reference. The chat app now uses the video route for video requests, and provider errors include a useful message when one is available.

Nova Reel accepts a `seed` for reproducible single-shot and multi-shot videos. Image and video paths now return HTTP 400 when a supplied image URL cannot be fetched; GPT Image and Flux Kontext also identify input images by their contents when a CDN supplies an unhelpful MIME type.

Publishable app keys can register multiple redirect URIs through the key dashboard and APIs, with authorization checking callbacks against the selected key. The BYOP consent screen also accepts a cleared budget field for an unlimited Pollen budget. Enter’s key controls, balance, pricing, and usage views picked up more consistent tooltips.

highlights.title: Generation has a new home
highlights.text: Send image, video, text, chat, and speech requests to `gen.pollinations.ai`; the interactive API reference moved there too. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Repeatable Nova Reel videos
highlights.text: Set `seed` on Nova Reel single-shot or multi-shot video requests to reproduce a result; use `-1` for a random seed. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Multiple app callback URLs
highlights.text: Register multiple redirect URIs for one publishable app key in Enter, so an app can have more than one authorized callback. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
